name: What permits are needed for a basement custom design project in cities like Pacifica or Daly City?

mainEntity.name: What permits are needed for a basement custom design project in cities like Pacifica or Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit requirements for basement custom design projects vary by municipality but typically include building, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical permits. Depending on the scope of work, such as adding egress windows or converting unfinished space into habitable area, additional permits may be necessary. We assist clients in navigating the permitting process with local Bay Area city planning departments to ensure full compliance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basement custom design projects in cities like Pacifica or Daly City typically require building, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical permits.
